text.en:
Section one, paragraph A (c) : Antique, item numbered 9; Bohol, item numbered 1; Cebu, items
numbered 1, 3, 31, 36, 37, 38, 39, and 43; Mountain Province, item numbered 11; and section one, paragraph
B (f) : Camarines Sur, item numbered 1 of Act Numbered Forty-two hundred and forty-one, is hereby
amended to read as follows:
